name: Crochet de réparation du ressort de lampe, concept F0 aluminium
description: Independent hollow hook concept for studying an additive repair of the lamp spring mount of a 993 headlamp. A commercial offer proves that metal printing is really used for this function, but no public dimension allows this F0 to be presented as its copy or as a fitted part.

classification.intended_use: CAD, LPBF and mechanical screening of a repair concept; no fitting and no lamp retention authorized

provenance.record_license: All rights reserved (see LICENSE) for the concept, the script and the calculations; no photo and no commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: Roadster-Fashion - printed headlamp spring hook for 993
sources.notes: The manufacturer claims 3D manufacture in aluminum or stainless steel, fitting onto the remaining hook by high-temperature bonding, and an M3 option if the base is broken. The images serve only to understand the function; no dimension or geometry is copied. See SRC-ROADSTER-FASHION-993-HEADLAMP-HOOK.

sources.title: EOS Aluminium AlSi10Mg for EOS M 290 - 30 micrometre process data sheet
sources.notes: Public TRL 9 route AlSi10Mg_FlexM291 2.01 / EOS M 290 / 30 µm and as-built coupon properties. Scan paths, supports, part allowables and a full hot-property card remain absent. See SRC-EOS-ALSI10MG-M290-30UM.

material.grade: EOS Aluminium AlSi10Mg / AlSi10Mg_FlexM291 2.01 / 30 µm, screening candidate not attributed to the commercial part
material.standard: DIN EN 1706 EN AC-43000 and ASTM F3318-18 per the EOS data sheet; supplier specification to be contracted

post_processing: removal of supports outside the cavity
controlled deburring of the spring groove
heat treatment tied to the machine and the parameter set
finishing of the bonding surface without rounding the future datums
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, orientation and batch
witness coupon in the critical orientation of the arm
CT or radiography of the root and dimensional inspection
thermal, vibration and retention tests before any vehicle use

titanium.galvanic_isolation: To be studied between printed aluminum, headlamp mount and fastener only after the real materials are identified.

known_limits: All F0 dimensions are independent design variables, not measurements of the product or of the headlamp.
The 30 N and 100 K case is synthetic and does not represent a measured 993 load or temperature.
The elastic check uses a room-temperature AlSi10Mg card and ignores LPBF defects, notches, fatigue and temperature.
The fine CalculiX thermal p95 of 141.90 MPa is a result on a synthetic gradient and fixed support; the local maximum of 303.47 MPa and the lack of hot strength data block any conclusion.
The ovphysx witness proves the loading and rigid contact of the USD mesh, not the spring function or the headlamp assembly.
The bonded joint has no allowable strength until adhesive, preparation, clearance and thermal cycle are qualified.
The STEP proves only a computable geometry; it must be neither printed for fitting nor installed in a headlamp.
